note_en: Final set: BLG vs GEN, Nov 14 19:00 UTC in Brooklyn. GEN 3-0'd IG; BLG ended T1's run 3-1. The model has GEN 54.7%, closer than the 62.5% market, and Knight is the MVP favourite. A last refresh lands one hour before kickoff. Entertainment only.
note_zh: 决赛对阵确定：BLG 对 GEN，北京时间 11 月 15 日 03:00 于布鲁克林开打。GEN 3-0 IG，BLG 3-1 终结 T1。模型给 GEN 54.7%，比市场 62.5% 更接近；Knight 为 MVP 热门。开赛前 1 小时将再更新一次。仅供娱乐。

series.reason_en: Elimination Bo3 between two 0-2 sides. The model and Polymarket (72.5%) both favour AL; no roster news changes the read.
series.reason_zh: 两支 0-2 队伍的淘汰 Bo3。模型与 Polymarket（72.5%）都看好 AL，暂无影响判断的阵容消息。
factors_en: Fearless: both pools sit at depth 30; AL's Nocturne (89% presence, 78% win rate) will likely be banned or burned early.
Market prices AL at 72.5% versus the model's 67.1%, so the blend leans away from TL.
Both teams are 0-2, so the loser is out of Worlds.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：双方英雄池深度均为 30；AL 的梦魇登场率 89%、胜率 78%，大概率被早禁或早用。
市场给 AL 72.5%，高于模型 67.1%，融合后更偏离 TL。
双方均 0-2，败者直接出局。

series.reason_en: Another 0-2 elimination Bo3. TSW is favoured at 63% (market 65.5%), with a 0-2 sweep the single most likely scoreline.
series.reason_zh: 又一场 0-2 淘汰 Bo3。TSW 胜率 63%（市场 65.5%），最可能比分为 0-2。
factors_en: Fearless: TSW has shown Ezreal, Qiyana and Rumble, all top-12 meta picks, giving it more flex options in games 2-3.
LOS's played pool leans on Syndra, Nocturne and Orianna, which are heavily contested and often banned.
The market (65.5%) and the model (63%) agree within three points.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：TSW 已用过伊泽瑞尔、奇亚娜、兰博等 meta 前 12 英雄，第二、三局可选面更宽。
LOS 已用英雄集中在辛德拉、梦魇、奥莉安娜，均为高争夺、常被禁用的位置。
市场 65.5% 与模型 63% 相差不足 3 个百分点。

series.reason_en: Bo1 at 1-1. BLG is favoured at 71.7%, and the market (70.5%) almost exactly agrees.
series.reason_zh: 1-1 组的 Bo1。BLG 胜率 71.7%，市场 70.5%，几乎一致。
factors_en: Fearless: KC has the shallowest pool at the event (depth 28) and leans on Kalista/Renata and Cassiopeia.
BLG's played pool (Akali, Orianna, Lee Sin, Nautilus) overlaps with high-presence meta picks.
Model and market are within 1.2 points, so the line is stable.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：KC 英雄池深度 28，全场最浅，依赖卡莉丝塔/芮娜塔与卡西奥佩娅。
BLG 已用阿卡丽、奥莉安娜、李青、诺提勒斯，与高登场率 meta 重合。
模型与市场相差仅 1.2 个百分点，盘面稳定。

series.reason_en: Bo1 at 1-1. The model has T1 at 75.6%; the market is more confident at 88.5%. One game means high variance.
series.reason_zh: 1-1 组的 Bo1。模型给 T1 75.6%，市场更乐观（88.5%）。单局定胜负，波动大。
factors_en: Fearless: in a Bo1 nothing carries over, so T1's depth of 29 versus CFO's 30 matters little; only bans shape the draft.
Vi, which T1 has played, has 91% presence but a 25% win rate. Whether T1 picks it again is a draft tell.
Market and model differ by 13 points, the widest gap among today's open series.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：Bo1 不存在跨局消耗，T1 深度 29 与 CFO 30 差异不大，仅禁用影响选人。
T1 用过的蔚登场率 91% 但胜率仅 25%，是否再拿是征召看点。
市场与模型相差 13 个百分点，为今日未开赛场次中分歧最大。

series.reason_en: IG beat TES 3-1, per press reports, reaching their first Worlds semifinal since 2019. The pre-match pick of TES at 52.2% missed, as did the TES 3-1 score call.
series.reason_zh: 据媒体报道，IG 3-1 击败 TES，时隔七年再进世界赛四强。赛前预测 TES 52.2% 与比分 TES 3-1 均未命中。
factors_en: Fearless: both teams entered with depth 36; game-by-game drafts for this series are not logged yet.
IG led every team on GD@15 (1613) coming in; TES had the field's lowest first-blood rate, 16.7%.
Score comes from press reports because gol.gg lists no score yet; game data will follow when it updates.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：两队赛前深度都是 36，本场逐局征召数据尚未录入。
IG 赛前 GD@15 为 1613 居首；TES 一血率 16.7% 全场最低。
比分来自媒体报道，gol.gg 尚未更新，逐局数据待补。

series.reason_en: The widest quarterfinal. The model has GEN at 86.6%, below the market's 90.5%, with 3-0 the likeliest score at 38.7%. GEN went 3-0 in Swiss and LYON 3-2, though LYON took a game off GEN in their Swiss meeting.
series.reason_zh: 八强悬殊最大的一场。模型给 GEN 86.6%，低于市场 90.5%，最可能比分 3-0（38.7%）。GEN 瑞士轮 3-0，LYON 3-2，但两队瑞士轮交手时 LYON 拿下过一局。
factors_en: Fearless: LYON's depth of 39 tops GEN's 32, and the model trims GEN for it; Syndra, Alistar, Anivia, Ezreal and Rumble sit in both logged pools.
GEN's 80.0% dragon rate is the best of all teams, while LYON's -867 GD@15 sits at the 0.133 percentile.
Dot Esports reports GEN beat LYON 2-1 in Swiss, so the 13.4% upset case has some precedent.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：LYON 深度 39 高于 GEN 的 32，模型因此略降 GEN。
GEN 小龙率 80.0% 全场最高，LYON 的 GD@15 为 -867。
瑞士轮 GEN 仅 2-1 胜 LYON，13.4% 冷门并非无据。

series.reason_en: Model and market agree: BLG 59.1% against a 58.5% quote, despite DK's 3-0 Swiss record against BLG's 3-2. BLG 3-1 is the likeliest score at 22.4%. Dplus won their Esports World Cup quarterfinal 2-1, per gol.gg.
series.reason_zh: 模型与市场一致：BLG 59.1%，市场 58.5%，尽管 DK 瑞士轮 3-0 优于 BLG 的 3-2。最可能比分 BLG 3-1（22.4%）。据 gol.gg，两队电竞世界杯八强战 DK 2-1 取胜。
factors_en: Fearless: both teams show depth 35 and share Vi, Lee Sin, Nautilus, Jarvan IV and Kai'Sa, so neither gains a pool edge.
BLG's 87.5% first-blood rate is near the top; DK sit at 50.0% but take first tower 75.0% of the time.
Mid is close: ShowMaker 9.0 KDA and +389 GD@15, Knight 8.4 KDA and +412; Viper's -463 GD@15 is BLG's soft spot.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：两队深度都是 35，共有蔚、李青、皇子、卡莎等。
BLG 一血率 87.5% 名列前茅；DK 一血 50.0%、一塔 75.0%。
中路接近：ShowMaker +389，Knight +412。

series.reason_en: T1 are 73.7% to win, 1-3 the likeliest score. The market is even firmer on T1 at 82.5%; the model keeps KC a little higher on their deeper champion pool.
series.reason_zh: T1 获胜概率 73.7%，最可能比分 1-3。预测市场对 T1 更看好（82.5%），模型因 KC 英雄池更深而给 KC 略高的胜率。
factors_en: Fearless depth: KC 39 unique champions vs T1 35, so KC has more fallback picks in games 4-5.
Swiss record: KC 3-2 went through a harder path; T1 finished 3-1.
Model 73.7% vs Polymarket 82.5% for T1; a gap of under 10 points, no sourced fact to adjust.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：KC 英雄池 39 个、T1 为 35 个，后期局 KC 备选更多。
瑞士轮战绩：KC 3-2 走得更艰难，T1 为 3-1。
模型 T1 73.7%，Polymarket 82.5%，差距不足 10 点，无可引用事实故不修正。

series.reason_en: GEN are 71.2% to win, 1-3 the likeliest score. Polymarket is at 80.5% for GEN. IG just beat TES 3-1, but the payload offers no new fact to adjust.
series.reason_zh: GEN 获胜概率 71.2%，最可能比分 1-3。Polymarket 给 GEN 80.5%。IG 刚 3-1 击败 TES，但 payload 中没有可据以修正的新事实。
factors_en: Fearless depth: IG 41 unique champions vs GEN 34; IG has the wider pool, GEN relies on proven picks.
GEN swept LYON 3-0 in the quarterfinal; IG needed four games against TES.
Model 71.2% vs market 80.5% for GEN; IG's pool depth explains part of the gap.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：IG 英雄池 41 个、GEN 为 34 个；IG 选择面更宽，GEN 依赖成熟选择。
GEN 八强 3-0 横扫 LYON；IG 对 TES 打满四局。
模型 GEN 71.2%，市场 80.5%；IG 的英雄池深度解释了部分差距。

series.reason_en: GEN are slight favourites: model 54.7% vs market 62.5%. GEN swept LYON and IG 3-0 without dropping a game; BLG beat DK 3-0 and ended T1's run 3-1. Most likely score GEN 3-1 (20.5%). The model rates BLG closer than the market does.
series.reason_zh: GEN 小幅占优：模型 54.7%，市场 62.5%。GEN 八强、四强两轮 3-0 未失一局；BLG 3-0 横扫 DK、3-1 终结 T1。最可能比分 GEN 3-1（20.5%）。模型认为 BLG 比市场估计的更接近。
factors_en: Fearless depth: BLG have shown 40 unique champions to GEN's 35, so BLG keep more comfort picks if the final goes to games four and five.
Form: GEN are 3-0 in Swiss and 6-0 in knockout games; BLG went 3-2 in Swiss but 6-1 in the bracket.
Mid duel: Knight (9.2 KDA, 357 GD@15) against Chovy (6.4 KDA, -93 GD@15) is the event's sharpest stat gap.
factors_zh: 无畏征召深度：BLG 已用 40 个英雄，GEN 35 个，打到第四、五局 BLG 余地更大。
状态：GEN 瑞士轮 3-0、淘汰赛 6-0；BLG 瑞士轮 3-2，淘汰赛 6-1。
中路对位：Knight KDA 9.2、15 分钟经济差 +357，Chovy 为 6.4 与 -93。

champion.reason_en: 54.8% (fair odds 1.82) against a 62.4% market. GEN reached the final 3-0 in Swiss and with two 3-0 sweeps over LYON and IG. The market prices that clean run harder than the model, which still credits BLG's 6-1 bracket record.
champion.reason_zh: 54.8%（公平赔率 1.82），市场 62.4%。GEN 瑞士轮 3-0，八强与四强分别 3-0 横扫 LYON、IG。市场对这条零失局路线定价更高，模型仍计入 BLG 淘汰赛 6-1 的战绩。

champion.reason_en: 45.2% (fair odds 2.21) against a 37.6% market, the largest model-market gap on the page. BLG swept DK 3-0 and beat T1 3-1, and Knight leads all mids with a 9.2 KDA. The 3-2 Swiss record keeps the model short of favourite.
champion.reason_zh: 45.2%（公平赔率 2.21），市场 37.6%，是全页模型与市场差距最大的一项。BLG 3-0 横扫 DK、3-1 击败 T1，Knight KDA 9.2 为中单最高；瑞士轮 3-2 让模型未把其列为热门。

mvp.basis_en: 21.8% (fair odds 4.59), the top MVP price. Knight has the best statline left in the event: 9.2 KDA, 667 DPM, 74.2% KP and +357 GD@15. If BLG win, he is the likeliest face of it.
mvp.basis_zh: 21.8%（公平赔率 4.59），MVP 最热门。Knight 数据为剩余选手最佳：KDA 9.2、分均伤害 667、参团率 74.2%、15 分钟经济差 +357。BLG 夺冠时他最可能当选。

mvp.basis_en: 19.3% (fair odds 5.18). GEN are favourites, but Chovy's -93 GD@15 makes him GEN's weakest player by the code's z-score, so the price sits below Knight's.
mvp.basis_zh: 19.3%（公平赔率 5.18）。GEN 是热门，但 Chovy 15 分钟经济差 -93，按代码评分是 GEN 最弱一环，因此价格低于 Knight。

mvp.basis_en: 19.1% (fair odds 5.24), tracking GEN's 54.8% title chance. Carry ADCs often take finals MVP, and this is Ruler's third Worlds final.
mvp.basis_zh: 19.1%（公平赔率 5.24），跟随 GEN 54.8% 的夺冠概率。决赛 MVP 常落在 C 位，这是 Ruler 第三次进世界赛决赛。

mvp.basis_en: 15.2% (fair odds 6.58). Canyon was named MVP of the 3-0 semifinal over IG, but junglers convert a GEN title into MVP less often than carries.
mvp.basis_zh: 15.2%（公平赔率 6.58）。Canyon 获四强 3-0 IG 系列赛 MVP，但打野把团队夺冠转化为 MVP 的比例低于 C 位。

mvp.basis_en: 14.4% (fair odds 6.94). Viper is BLG's second option behind Knight; his Guardian Angel survival closed out the semifinal against T1.
mvp.basis_zh: 14.4%（公平赔率 6.94）。Viper 是 BLG 次选；四强对 T1 的收官团中他靠守护天使存活。

mvp.basis_en: 10.3% (fair odds 9.71). Kiin is GEN's best player by the code's z-score (7.4 KDA, +314 GD@15), but top laners rarely win finals MVP.
mvp.basis_zh: 10.3%（公平赔率 9.71）。按代码评分 Kiin 是 GEN 最佳选手（KDA 7.4、经济差 +314），但上单很少拿决赛 MVP。
